podcast.body: This was The Ramones' final album, aptly titled "Adios Amigos." The band joked that they would continue recording only if the album performed well on the charts, reflecting their ongoing resentment of historically poor chart fortunes. It spent only two weeks on the Billboard 200 album chart, peaking at number 148, but yielded a minor hit single with their cover of Tom Waits' "I Don't Want to Grow Up," which cracked the modern rock chart at number 30. "They recorded one last album, the aptly titled Adios Amigos, in 1995."
